content: Subtraction is the mathematical operation of finding the difference between two numbers by taking one away from another. It is the inverse of addition. The result of subtraction is called the difference. For example, 5 minus 3 equals 2. Subtraction is represented by the minus sign (-) and is a core arithmetic skill.
